title: E lucevan le stelle
subtitle: A circle, and time. No beginning, no end.

trails.title: White Envelope
trails.description: A reply on how to best take care of daggers and hand mirrors.

content.text:
Ms. Marcus, Level Two Investigator:

Regarding the matters of the arcanists "Isolde" and "Kakania," the headquarters of the St. Pavlov Foundation has been fully informed of the situation, and the Special Assessment Department is now working on containment measures. We thank you for your efforts.

Please stay out of harm's way and move to a safe area before the "Storm" arrives.

At this time, the St. Pavlov Foundation's temporary containment plan is as follows:

▪ Unregistered arcanist, Isolde von Dittarsdorf

A preliminary threat assessment report has been prepared, and the subject meets the Level III containment criteria in the St. Pavlov Foundation's underground shelter.

We will temporarily mobilize the "Razor" squad, a special operations squad stationed in Prague, to arrive in Vienna and assist the investigative team in any way possible to ensure their safety throughout the containment process.

▪ Unregistered arcanist, Klara Vingler

A preliminary threat assessment report has been prepared, the subject poses a low level of danger. In accordance with the "Containment Management Regulations (Document No. 003)", no mandatory containment measures will be taken. Please ensure her safety, as she will be subpoenaed in the future as a material witness to the Vienna incident in accordance with the law.

May the peace be with us.

St. Pavlov Foundation Headquarters

items.text: E lucevan le stelle

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: You have everything wrapped up.
Kakania shuts the door, dimming the apocalyptic clamor outside.
The clinic remains cluttered, empty, quiet.
Only the mirrors no longer flash.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Yes. The mirror scares me after what happened.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: It truthfully reflects my ugly face, my disgusting soul.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: You're not disgusting, doctor. How can someone disgusting have noble, high ideals like yours?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Hah, perhaps. Maybe you're right. It's time to lift the cloth.
Kakania pulls back the curtain.
The dim room suddenly brightens.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Ooh!

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: The light hurts, did you open the curtains?

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Doctor, I can't see!
An overexposed world slowly reveals a painting.
And a strange, cold voice.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Look at this painting, Isolde.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Does it remind you of anything?

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: I can't see it clearly, doctor ... It's too bright in here ...

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Can you pull the curtains? Just a bit ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: This is the painting of your late brother, The Salvation.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: We've overlooked a simple fact, Isolde. Until Heinrich's final words reminded us all.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Theophil wrote his note in despair, yet he called his last painting The Salvation.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Doctor, it's too bright in here. Can we please talk somewhere else?
She waits for a response of concern or pity.
But she receives none.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: How could I have missed this, Isolde? A noble lady such as you not only can sing and dance, but also draw.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Theophil was a fine gentleman, but only fine. He was skilled, but not gifted. The women of the Dittarsdorfs have always been better mediums than the men. You're much more gifted than your brother ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Should we be thankful of the two of you? You and your brother, a pair of messiahs of this era. One of you cried out and revealed the truth in a pitiful poem, and kept his despair in the form of art.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: Ugh ... Doctor ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: And the other ... wished to "scrape the paint off the top, reveal its true colors, and reshape it."

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: That's you, Isolde. You tried to scrape off the despair and reshape the world with your compassionate, pitying hands.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: He created the art, and you completed it.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: You and your brother are the co-creators of this painting, out of your pity for this world.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: ... And that's why it was the only work that survived the fire.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Am I right, Isolde? Tell me!
Kakania's words carry weight.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: With Heinrich's help, the two of you met the leader of Manus Vindictae. You saw the miracle, you were shown the path to salvation.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: But poor Theophil could not accept what he was told. Like you, he was cursed by his noble blood. He sympathized with the world, yet he still clung to the privileges of nobility.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: He didn't want to work with Manus Vindictae, but he didn't want war either.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: He had his struggles. As a beneficiary of the salvation, writing of despair was his only way to vent.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: He had to take his life to end the pain. And he wanted you to join him, so that you and he would be free of the torment together.

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: But he overlooked the fact that, unlike him, you were already living in despair. Everything he had and cared about had never been yours. The destruction of this world meant nothing to you.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: My, my head really hurts ...

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: So you pulled the trigger on him, out of pity.

items.speaker: Isolde
items.text: I can't see anything ... Can you please dim the room?

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: Look at this painting! Look at these mirrors, Isolde!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: What did the leader of Manus Vindictae show you?! What is "the path to salvation"?! Is it a spell? A ritual?!

items.speaker: Kakania
items.text: You're the only one who knows!!!
